row_order: ascending sort over all grouping keys (deterministic)

columns.name: month
columns.meaning: first day of the UTC post month (YYYY-MM-01); empty means unknown period

columns.name: breakdown
columns.meaning: marginal grouping family: total, topic, views_tier, likes_tier, reposts_tier, replies_tier

columns.name: category
columns.meaning: category inside the breakdown; topic categories below 5 are merged into other_topic_lt5

columns.name: post_count
columns.meaning: number of input posts in this monthly marginal group (>= 5 for non-total publication cells)

unit: one row = one monthly marginal group of posts (never one post); total breakdown rows sum to the input row count
observed_vs_derived: post_count and all coarse tiers are derived; month/compound/topic labels are observed group keys carried from the private input and collection metadata
not_present: no tweet_id_hash, author_id, text, URL, exact datetime, or exact engagement count appears in any column or value
